concepts.def: Subjective meanings attached to location: insider/outsider, near/far perceptions; studied by humanistic geographers like Tuan.
Edward Relph's 1976 term for homogenised landscapes lacking distinctive character; e.g. airport terminals, chain stores.
Internal characteristics shaping place: location, topography, demographics, land use, history; root identity.
External relationships: migration, capital flows, government policy, tourism; constantly reshape places.
Place marketing changing image to attract investment, residents, tourists; e.g. Liverpool Capital of Culture 2008.
Ruth Glass's 1964 term for middle-class arrival in working-class areas; rising rents displace original residents; e.g. Hackney.
